description.describe_ch: 目的是為研究時間序列數據提供分析的工具,並介紹時間序列模型的基本理論,及學習單變量和多變量模式的分析，包括辨識、估計、診斷分析和預測。
description.describe_eh: The goals are provides tools for time series data and is an introduction into the theoretical foundation of time series models. To learn univariate and multivariate models included identification, estimation, diagnostic checking, and forecasting.

targets.describe_ch: 理解Box-Jenkins 模式的分析，包括辨識、估計、診斷分析和預測
targets.describe_en: To comprehend the analysis of Box-Jenkins models, included identification, estimation, diagnostic checking, and forecasting.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
期末報告注意事項
  1. 請採用逢甲大學圖書館優質學生報告WORD檔案繕打你們的報告。可以搜尋過去的相關的研究，但是請勿抄襲歷史的優質學生報告。
  2. 請使用逢甲大學圖書館Turnitin論文原創性比對服務方式，比對文件稱為相似度報告，扣除參考文獻，相似度不得超過20%。
  3. 請選擇合適的報告題目。在研究報告有效力的標題有幾個特點:
  1. 準確地顯示了研究主題和範圍 ;
  2. 避免用縮寫，除非該所寫非常廣為人知 ;
  3. 使用字創造積極的印象和激發讀者的興趣;
  4. 使用當前命名法。
  5. 標題是通常在一個短語的形式，但也可以是一個問題的形式, e.g. : Gold and the US dollar: Hedge or heaven? 很少論文題目是用驚嘆號。
  1. 報告長度不超過40頁為原則, 包括圖表及電腦輸出結果。內文內容，請用12號字體，中文字一律用標楷體，英文字一律用Times New Roman. 参數符號則用希臘字。段落請選擇最小行高，18pt.
  2. 報告需要提供一頁摘要，在創建一個有效率摘要，請就本期末報告目的、使用的研究方法，評估準則，分析結果作一概述，無需分段。摘要需要簡潔，傳遞重要訊息。避免使用縮寫和公式。摘要在呈現你的文中簡短，清晰的總結。精心準備摘要使讀者能夠快速準確地識別的基本內容，以確定其關係到他/她的興趣或目的，然後決定是否要閱讀整篇文章。
  3. 關鍵字扮演重要的角色，依本計畫性質自訂六個關鍵詞，譬如 樣本外預測。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Classroom Rules:
Being Punctual! Food and drinks must be kept outside the computer lab.
Class Communication: If you have questions, discuss them directly with the instructor. Avoid private conversations that may disrupt the class.
Assignment Submission: All assignments must be submitted by the deadline. Late submissions will not be accepted.
Collaboration: Discussion is allowed, but each student must complete their own work independently.
Final Project: The final project is due in the last week of the semester. Details will be announced in class.
No Mobile Phones: Please do not use your phone during class.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Respect: Treat everyone in the classroom with politeness and kindness. This includes actively listening when others are speaking and valuing
different opinions and perspectives.
Participation: Actively participate in classroom activities, discussions, and the learning process. This includes engaging thoughtfully in
discussions, asking questions, and collaborating with peers.
Preparation: Come to the classroom prepared to learn. Please have all necessary books and lecture notes ready, complete homework, and be
prepared to engage with the day's topic.
Attention: Pay attention to the professor and classmates during discussions and presentations. This is crucial for absorbing information and
effectively participating.
Responsibility: Take responsibility for your own actions and learning. This includes adhering to deadlines and classroom rules, and not violating
academic honesty.
Patience and Tolerance: Be patient with others and understand different perspectives. This is especially important in a learning environment
where classmates come from diverse backgrounds and have different learning styles.
Punctuality: Be on time for class and return promptly after breaks. This shows respect for the professor and classmates and ensures that you do
not miss any part of the lesson.
Appropriate Communication: Use language and tone suitable for the classroom environment. This includes avoiding disruptive or disrespectful
speech.
Digital Etiquette: If using computers and tablets in the classroom, use them responsibly and only for learning purposes, not for personal
entertainment.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
All of the following are considered plagiarism:
turning in someone else's work as your own copying words or ideas from someone else without giving credit
failing to put a quotation in quotation marks giving incorrect information about the source of a quotation
changing words but copying the sentence structure of a source without giving credit
copying so many words or ideas from a source that it makes up the majority of your work, whether you give credit or not
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Academic integrity is essential to a fair and respectful learning environment. Students are expected to complete all coursework independently and honestly. The following behaviors may be considered violations:
  • Plagiarism: Using others’ work without proper citation
  • Data fabrication: Making up or altering data or results
  • Reusing prior work: Submitting previously completed material without permission
  • Unauthorized assistance: Having someone else complete your assignment, exam, or report
  • Misconduct during assessments: Cheating or using unauthorized resources
If a breach of academic integrity is confirmed, the corresponding assessment may receive a mark of zero.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Deliberate breaches of academic honesty constitute academic misconduct, such as:
  1. Plagiarism
  2. Fabrication of data
  3. Recycling previously submitted material
  4. Engaging someone else to complete an assessment or exam on one's behalf
  5. Misconduct during supervised assessments
The penalties for academic misconduct may include:
  1. A mark of zero on the assessment
  2. A fail grade in the unit of study
故意違反學術誠信規範構成學術不端行為，例如：
  1. 抄襲
  2. 數據捏造
  3. 重複使用先前提交的材料
  4. 委託他人代替完成作業或報告
  5. 在作業，期中報告，期末報告中有以上不當行為
學術不端行為的處罰可能包括：
  1. 評量得分為零
  2. 該學習單元成績不及格
